note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-24 (cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5, S5/S6/S7 claude-opus-4-8; GO — STRUCTURE certified faithful, magnitudes hand-validated vs the T5 wind-weak recording; see scripts/kit-autonomy/manual-review/velvet.md). Hand-verified vs a real scope-lock run (wind-weak probe comp). TWO MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE MODES (owner ruling 2026-08-13), and she is built to play as the OFF-B2. UNSWAPPED (a teammate takes the Burst II slot): every full charge inside Full Burst feeds S2 block 1, her team buff — ATK 25.2% of HER ATK (casterAtkPct, a flat add) + Charge Damage 100.8%, 3s, refreshed per shot. SWAPPED (she casts): her burst replaces the SR with a machine gun — no wind-up, 60 rounds/sec, no ammo and no reload, 10s from the cast instant — which cannot full-charge, so block 1 is gated off (swapGate:'unswapped') and every buff she holds is self-targeted. The MG is what makes S2 block 2 reachable: ~9.1s of the 10s swap overlaps Full Burst at 60/s, so the 'landing 50 normal attacks during Full Burst' proc (400.92% of final ATK + self Attack Damage 15.03%/5s) fires ~10x per window — the whole payload of her own burst. Her SR cannot reach it (36 in-FB shots across a fight in the off-B2 fixture, 7.2 per window, against a threshold of 50), so the two blocks effectively partition her kit by mode. Swap fields: weapon 'MG' (MG range/core banding; the MG wind-up ladder is base-weapon-gated, so a swap INTO MG starts at full cadence — sim.ts NOMINAL_PULLS_PER_SEC), pullsPerSec 60 (owner-ruled, stated explicitly rather than inherited from the class table), chargeTimeSec 0, maxAmmo 999 (the no-reload idiom, as laplace: 600 rounds per window never exhausts it). S1's self ATK 30.5% + Attack Damage 30.5% (3s, per full-charge shot) is text-gated 'while NOT in Full Burst' → fbGate:'outFb' (hard cutoff; in-game ~3s of carryover into each FB is lost, slight undercount). ⚡ S1 keeps the plain shotFired proxy for 'Full Charge attack', so it ALSO refreshes on MG rounds during a swap that sits outside Full Burst (3308 applications vs ~300 pre-MG). The 2026-08-13 ruling was scoped to S2, and the effect is damage-neutral — the 3s buff was already at ~100% uptime off SR shots every 1.5s — but it is a trigger-premise inconsistency: if 'the MG does not full-charge' extends to S1, this block wants swapGate:'unswapped' too. AMMO POUCH — a build/consume stack resource, NOT her magazine (owner ruling 2026-08-13), and never binding, so it is dropped entirely: 'entering Burst Stage 2' is a team rotation state that fires whenever the chain reaches stage 2 regardless of who casts, so the pouch refills to its 6000 cap every rotation against a worst-case spend of ~3,450 while bursting (10 procs x 300, plus out-of-FB full charges at 100) and ~2,450 unswapped (in-FB full charges at 300). Every ammo-gated effect therefore fires at full uptime. The enemy bullet-steal half of Bullet Snatch is resource/defensive (skipped). SR fire cycle = the universal 60f charge + 30f bolt recovery rule (no charFixes; reproduces the validated 90-frame cycle).

skill1: Bullet Snatch (battle start + Burst Stage 2): removes 5% ammo from all enemies; fills own ammo pouch to 6,000 rounds.
Full Charge attack while not in Full Burst: expends 100 ammo from the ammo pouch.
skill2: Full Charge attack during Full Burst: expends 300 ammo from the ammo pouch.
Landing 50 normal attacks during Full Burst: expends 300 ammo from the ammo pouch.

caveats: skill2: the hitCount:50 counter accrues on EVERY normal attack, and a threshold crossing the inFb gate then blocks still spends its 50 — so shots the kit would not count ('landing 50 normal attacks during Full Burst') still advance the counter. Engine-wide hitCount semantics, not velvet-specific. The two readings CONVERGE while swap shots dominate — cumulative counting fires 55 procs in the sole-B2 fixture against the in-FB-only reading's 2740/50 = 54, since both reduce to in-FB shots ÷ 50 — and DIVERGE at low volume: unswapped she lands only 36 in-FB shots in a fight, so the kit-literal reading fires zero while the cumulative counter leaks exactly one (her 100th overall shot crosses 50 with a Full Burst live). Both counts are pinned in her spec test; closing the gap needs an in-FB-scoped counter on the hitCount trigger, which is a cross-cutting engine change filed for the owner rather than made here.

burst: the swap's per-shot damage is the kit's flat 7% of final ATK, and MG banding means her swap shots take MG range/core treatment rather than the SR's — faithful to a real weapon change, but kit-silent.

burst: her MG generates NO burst gauge — real weapon changes contribute nothing (owner ruling 2026-08-13, engine-wide in shotGauge). Before that ruling every 1-frame MG round was credited her SNIPER's per-shot energy (5.6, a charged SR shot) because gaugePerShot keys off the unit's own weapon, refilling the whole bar in 0.3s once a stalled chain lifted the gauge lock mid-swap. ⚡ Her Full Bursts still land 90-126 frames earlier than under the old SR-economy swap, and that is NOT the gauge: it is the RELOAD-CYCLE PHASE ripple (isolated by A/B — the shift is identical with and without the gauge fix). The MG carries its own magazine and hands the SR back full, so her reloads go 10 → 0 and her first post-swap SR shot lands 30f earlier, moving her own gauge contribution once the lock lifts. Same faithful-collateral class as jill (DECISIONS 2026-08-10); do not re-tune gauge to chase it.
